chunks: Humayd, from Ibn Sama'ah, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Muhammad ibn Mas'ud al-Ta'i, from Anbasah ibn Mus'ab, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever faces a funeral or sees it and says: Allah is the Greatest. This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us, and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth. O Allah, increase us in faith and submission.'
Praise is for Allah Who was strengthened by power and subdued the servants with death. No angel remains in the sky except that he weeps out of mercy for his voice.'

key_terms.رَحْمَةً لِصَوْتِهِ: Out of mercy for his voice

ai.seo_question: What should one say when seeing a funeral in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith links the Prophet’s words to Imam al-Sadiq, emphasizing the funeral as a tangible manifestation of divine promise (wa'd) and a moment for spiritual reflection. It highlights the cosmic significance of death, noting that even angels weep in mercy at the sound of the death call, reinforcing the Shia practice of viewing mortality as a transition to the afterlife rather than a mere end.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd, from Ibn Sama’at, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Muhammad Bin Masoud Al Ta’iy, from Anbasa Bin Mus’ab,
(It has been narrated)from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>  said: ‘The one who comes across a funeral or sees it, so he should say,

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is the Greatest! This is what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> Promised us, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> spoke the truth. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Increase us in Eman (faith) and submission.

The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Honoured us with the Ordainment, and Subdued the servants with the death. There does not remain an Angel in the sky except that he weeps pitifully for his Voice’.
en.sarwar: 3. Humayd has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jabalah from Muhammad ibn Mas’ud al-Ta’i from ‘Anbasah ibn Mus’ab who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah has said, ‘

If one finds a dead body brought from the opposite direction or just sees one and says, “Allah is great. This is what Allah and His Messenger have told us will happen to us and Allah and His Messenger have indeed spoken the truth. O Lord, increase our belief and submission. All praise belongs to Allah who is Most Majestic due to His power and who has subdued people by death,”
no angel is left in the heavens but will weep out of sympathy for the tone of his voice.””’
